Lantern: realistic lantern as the logo

GPT's photoreal lantern used directly as the mark, in two crops, shown where the logo actually lives: app icons, favicon sizes, the wordmark, and the Slack bot avatar that every employee sees.

Crop 1

Full lantern

The whole lantern including the bail handle. Most recognizable at large sizes; at 20 px and below the handle and frame get very thin.
